title: Plan migration from version 1.0
summary: Inventory dependencies and move a retired Apex Control Hub configuration to a supported software version.

sections.title: Support status
paragraphs: Version 1.0 is retired and no longer receives maintenance updates. Existing systems should be isolated while migration is planned.

warning.condition: A retired controller remains reachable from untrusted networks.
warning.consequence: Known defects can remain exposed without a supported remediation path.
warning.avoidance: Restrict network access and prioritize migration to a maintained release.
